# Every recipe is a site; the verdict is the shell guest's, measured with
# `xnl check` 2026-09-27: only `check` is flagged (`sequence`).
build | shell | JustRecipe | sh errexit nounset | - | "cargo build --release"
check | shell | JustRecipe | sh errexit nounset | - | "bash scripts/lint.sh\nbats tests/unit"
hello | shell | JustShebangRecipe | bash | - | "#!/usr/bin/env bash\necho hello"
